description: Seed list of deliverable tasks per VIOS Practice stage, used by vios-engage:vios-engagement-setup to fill the client's single '<Client> — Deliverables' list (one list, Stage field per task; statuses from setup/clickup.json). Only the stages in scope are seeded. Since 2026-11-02 there are no lists per stage; the 'statuses' block below is kept for the record of the pre-2026-11-02 layout.

lists.name: Engagement
lists.note: The six keys of status.json > stages.Engagement.deliverables (docs/skill-contract.md); ClickUp task names carry the client: 'Intake <Client>', 'Proposal <Client> vN', 'Setup <Client>', 'Baseline <Client>', 'Harvest <Client>', 'Report <Client> <Month YYYY>'. Intake and Proposal are moved in from 'Department - Setup & SOP' at setup step 2, not re-created; the chase list is the Open facts list; the case recommendation is harvest step 4.
